data.exact_reserve_text: During 2020 the syndicate released prior year reserves of $16.5m (2019: $3.7m). Specialty Lines and cyber & executive risk had releases of $8.2m and $1.5m respectively. Both specialty lines and cyber & executive risk have been impacted over the past few years by the increased claims seen on their liability books resulting in decreased releases. Action taken in the marine division to remediate selected areas of the account, including the closing of the UK marine portfolio in January 2020, have resulted in a release of $1.9m in the division. Both the property and reinsurance divisions have benefitted from releases on some of the 2019 natural catastrophe events, namely Storm Dorian in the US and Typhoons Hagibis and Faxai in Japan.

data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate recorded a net prior-year release of $16.5m in 2020 (approx. -2.0% of opening gross claims outstanding of $821.8m). Releases were concentrated in Specialty Lines (release $8.2m) and Cyber & Executive Risk ($1.5m), with marine remediation contributing a further release ($1.9m). Property and Reinsurance benefitted from releases relating to certain 2019 natural catastrophe events (Storm Dorian, Typhoons Hagibis and Faxai). Overall the prior year movement is a release driven by favourable claims development and resolution of some prior nat-cat exposures.

data.data_quality_notes: All amounts are reported in the native currency (USD). Opening reserves taken from Balance Sheet 'Claims outstanding' prior-year comparative (31 Dec 2019 closing balance = opening at 1 Jan 2020). Prior year movement uses the explicit narrative statement 'released prior year reserves of $16.5m' (report does not present a single gross-movement reconciliation table labelled 'Movement in prior year's provision' with a gross column separate from current-year movement), and division breakdown table matches the $16.5m total. The report contains a gross claims development triangle (pages 50-53) but detailed per-development-period amounts were not extracted into the structured triangle due to format (percentages + totals across several pages). Some LOB mappings (e.g. 'Political, Accident & Contingency' -> 'Aggregate', 'Specialty Lines'->'Professional Lines', 'Reinsurance'->'Treaty') are approximate mappings to the standard list; see original segment names in gross_premium_mix. The document is denominated in USD though field names use '_gbp_m' per request schema.
